label: durability level majorityAndPersistActive
type: the durability level requiring a mutation to be replicated to a majority of nodes AND persisted to disk on the active node. Selectable only for Couchbase buckets, never Ephemeral ones, and offered as a bucket-level Minimum Durability Level.
evidence: You can choose this level only for Couchbase buckets.
In the **Minimum Durability Level** list, select a durability level for the bucket:
note: Completes the durability: level family (durability:level, level-majority, level-persist-to-majority were already promoted) - and round 26 found the reason the last member was missing is that it is the one with a bucket-type restriction, so it appears in the procedures rather than the level reference. The round also filed a docs-issue here: create-bucket.md and edit-bucket.md do not agree on the Minimum Durability Level options they offer.
